question: Before learning any subspace, determine whether the full MLP15 and MLP17 bilinear responses to the head-11.3 Task-14 interchange are live outside the previously measured direction and whether their depth-ordered joint intervention is executable.

trajectory.H: the same recipient prompt with only attention head 11.3's final-token pre-output value replaced by the relation's natural donor value
trajectory.background_for_single_module_f: run the H trajectory to layer l, override only z_l, then recompute every later operation normally

signed_single_module_interventions.definition: For f_l evaluated in the fixed H upstream background, delta=z_H-z_B and P=I_4608.
signed_single_module_interventions.removal: E_remove = f_l(z_H - P delta) - f_l(z_H); target E_full
signed_single_module_interventions.sufficiency: E_suff = f_l(z_B + P delta) - f_l(z_B); target -E_full

exact_bilinear_expansion.identity: delta_z_l = (W_L x_B) odot (W_R dx_l) + (W_L dx_l) odot (W_R x_B) + (W_L dx_l) odot (W_R dx_l)
exact_bilinear_expansion.phase0_required_closure: max_abs(delta_z_l-(t_BR+t_LB+t_RR)) <= 1e-5 for every relation and module
exact_bilinear_expansion.phase0B_status: preregistered but not authorized or included in the Phase0 price
exact_bilinear_expansion.phase0B_arms: For each module and relation, evaluate all 8 subsets S of {t_BR,t_LB,t_RR} in the same fixed H upstream background at z_S=z_B+sum_{t in S}t.
exact_bilinear_expansion.phase0B_composition: Use the 8-cell Boolean factorial to report three main effects, three pair interactions, and the three-way interaction on signed answer margin and full-vocabulary logits.

phase0B_price.explanation: six new subset states for each of two modules; empty and full are reused from Phase0
phase0B_price.joint_cross_module_term_factorial: deferred; a 64-condition cross-module factorial is not silently included

exact_bilinear_expansion.interpretation: Term effects are causal computations relative to the Task14 counterfactual. Product vectors are still interpreted only through W_D and modulo ker(W_D).

depth_ordered_joint.cached_factorial_status: diagnostic prior context only; it does not establish endogenous recomputation
reset: run H to MLP15 and replace z15_H by z15_B
at MLP17 record the newly recomputed z17_after_15_reset
rescue: run the same H background and install z15_B+delta15=z15_H at MLP15
continue normally and record the resulting current z17
define its live delta17=current_z17-z17_B and install z17_B+delta17=current_z17
depth_ordered_joint.required_diagnostic: retain norm and hash of z17_after_15_reset-z17_H, plus the ordered hook-provenance record and counters below; a norm/hash alone is not proof of live recomputation

required_hook_provenance.capture_rule: z17_after_15_reset must be copied from the live MLP17 product-hook input reached after the MLP15 reset; a cached z17_H or precomputed substitute is forbidden

depth_ordered_joint.note: The joint rescue endpoint should reproduce H, but it is executed separately as a hook liveness check.

metrics.signed_coefficient: beta_G = -dot(e_G,h_G)/dot(h_G,h_G); beta>0 restores the native answer effect and beta<0 is compensatory
metrics.coherence: c_G = abs(dot(e_G,h_G))/(norm(e_G) norm(h_G)); report the signed dot separately
metrics.control_scale: FIT median absolute target head effect, frozen once and reused for FIT and SELECT controls
metrics.full_vocab_summary: per relation RMS and maximum absolute logit change; full vocabulary arrays are reduced online and not retained

broad_task14_response.joint_required_in_each_directional_cell: q_G >= 0.10 and c_G >= 0.50 separately for recipient_subject_state=-1 and +1 in each of paired, cross_noun, literal_cross_syntax, and complete_subject_transfer
broad_task14_response.single_module_required: at least one of MLP15 or MLP17 has q_G >= 0.05 separately in both recipient states of every target class
broad_task14_response.interpretation: The path is broader than the previously observed direction; report beta_G and its sign rather than forcing restoration.

direction_specific_response.gated_effect: the depth-ordered joint MLP15-plus-MLP17 reset effect; single-module q values are reported but do not determine this terminal
direction_specific_response.required_live_direction: the depth-ordered joint effect in paired recipient_subject_state=+1 (plural recipient with singular donor; the previously live plural-to-singular direction) has q_G >= 0.10
direction_specific_response.required_weak_opposite_direction: the depth-ordered joint effect in paired recipient_subject_state=-1 has q_G < 0.05
direction_specific_response.required_lack_of_breadth: for the depth-ordered joint effect, in at least two of {cross_noun,literal_cross_syntax,complete_subject_transfer}, at least one separately reported recipient-state cell has q_G < 0.05
direction_specific_response.interpretation: Retain the label direction-specific compensatory response; do not claim a general subject-number feature.

opposing_predictions.intermediate_or_mixed: Anything between the two frozen patterns; report every signed cell and do not upgrade the claim.
opposing_predictions.control_failure: control RMS module effect divided by FIT target head scale > 0.20 for any registered control arm

reporting.screen_language: causal screen only; not a learned circuit, OOD result, or unique representation

product_space_identifiability.observable_object: delta_y_l = W_D,l delta_z_l and the induced downstream causal output function
product_space_identifiability.equivalence: delta_z and delta_z+n are observationally identical at the MLP output whenever n is in ker(W_D)
product_space_identifiability.allowed_future_claim: a causal output function represented by a dense compiled quadratic tensor or an explicitly quotient-aware equivalence class

unrelated_behavior_control.reason: the current numbered-list circuit is causally live at L8H7/L8H3 with candidate MLP8-14 writes, not established at MLP15/17; a ratio with a near-zero MLP15/17 denominator could pass trivially
unrelated_behavior_control.future_entry_condition: choose an unrelated behavior with a preregistered MLP15/17 full-module causal liveness floor before scoring collateral effects

price.runtime_cap: must be measured and frozen with the eventual hashed runner before execution

execution_boundary: No model or GPU run is authorized by this contract. A create-only runner amendment must freeze runner/source hashes, exact retained bytes, measured runtime, and managed-queue entry.
